test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the highlighted words in the given sentence.

The serenity of the river was **a sight to behold.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary focus of the sentence is on the serenity of the river.
 
• The phrase** "a sight to behold" **suggests something that is visually pleasing.
 
• The most appropriate substitution for **"a sight to behold"** is **"pleasant to see"** as it maintains the original meaning.
 
• Other options like** "confusing for all"** and **"ready to be sold" **do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The serenity of the river was **pleasant to see**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "confusing for all"** – This does not convey the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "ready to be sold"** – This is irrelevant in the context of describing serenity.
 
• **Option 3: "inviting for boating"** – Although somewhat related, it does not capture the visual pleasure aspect.
 
• **Option 4: "pleasant to see"** – This is the most fitting substitution as it aligns with the original meaning of** "a sight to behold".**
